# Challenge stages — what each id means

<!-- CONTEXT: reference | LAYER: on-demand -->
Status: generated | Owner: tools/stage_reference.py | Verified: on every run of tools/verify.ps1

**Do not edit this file by hand.** It is generated from
`scripts/challenge_stages.gd` by `python tools/stage_reference.py`, which
`tools/verify.ps1` re-runs with `--check` so the two cannot drift.

**Why it exists.** Any check, plan or session note that names a stage id
must either say what happens at that stage in the same sentence, or link
here (Dave, 8 Sep 2026). "C-5 needs a run past 2.1" tells a reader
nothing; "past 2.1, where the nectar stores fall and recover" does.

## Challenge 1 — the founding queen

| Stage | Goal, as the player sees it | Internal goal check | What the player does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `1.1` | watch the queen open the way into the hive. | `entrance_tunnel_cleared` | -- |
| `1.2` | guide the queen into the newly opened cavity. | `queen_reached_cavity` | right-click the marked cavity to send her in |
| `1.3` | select the queen. | `queen_selected` | left-click the queen to select her |
| `1.4` | inspect the three marked places in the cavity. | `hive_points_visited` | right-click each marked place in the cavity |
| `1.5` | build the colony's first comb cell. | `first_cell_built` | use Build cell, then click the marked centre |
| `1.6` | send the queen out to the meadow. | `queen_reached_meadow` | right-click the marked doorway to send her outside |
| `1.7` | explore the three marked places in the meadow. | `meadow_points_visited` | right-click each marked place in the meadow |
| `1.8` | gather from a flower. | `first_flower_collected` | right-click a flower to gather from it |
| `1.9` | gather from another flower. | `second_flower_collected` | right-click another flower to gather from it |
| `1.10` | return to the hive and deposit the harvest. | `harvest_deposited` | right-click the hive, then right-click the wax cell |
| `1.11` | automate nectar gathering. | `nectar_target` | give her the Forager role with nectar focus |
| `1.12` | build a second comb cell. | `second_cell_built` | use Build cell to place a second cell |
| `1.13` | set the new cell aside for pollen. | `pollen_cell_designated` | designate the second cell for pollen |
| `1.14` | automate pollen gathering. | `pollen_target` | switch her focus to pollen |
| `1.15` | build a third cell for the colony's next generation. | `third_cell_built` | use Build cell to place a third cell |
| `1.16` | let the queen lay the colony's first egg. | `first_egg_laid` | -- |
| `1.17` | care for the egg until the first worker hatches. | `nectar_forager_hatched` | -- |
| `1.18` | select the new worker. | `new_bee_selected` | -- |
| `1.19` | send the new worker out into the meadow. | `new_bee_left_hive` | -- |
| `1.20` | -- | `complete` | -- |

## Where the rest of a stage lives

Dr Gallerin's per-stage prompt lines, the `unlocked_keys` each stage
opens up and the delays those prompts fire on are all in the same
records in `scripts/challenge_stages.gd`; only the four columns above are
reproduced here, because they are the ones a reader needs to know which
stage is being talked about.

Challenge 2's rescue and failure thresholds (`C2_RESCUE_THRESHOLD`,
`C2_RESCUE_AMOUNT`, `C2_FAILURE_FLOOR`) are constants in the same file,
and the branch that reads them is
`scripts/challenge_runner.gd::_check_c2_failure`.
